description: Imani must decide whether to accept Noah for a summer room-share and set the final rent, occupancy, chore, quiet-hour, and guest terms after a scheduled household meeting with Noah and Celeste.

shared_context.S1: Imani's furnished spare bedroom is available for an informal summer room-share from June 1 through August 31.
shared_context.S2: The room includes a bed, desk, and access to the shared kitchen and bathroom.
shared_context.S3: Imani makes the final call on whether to arrange the room-share and sets the verbal terms.
shared_context.S4: Before agreeing, Imani normally checks the prospective tenant's proposed terms and the current housemate's household requirements.
shared_context.S5: The household keeps a written list of the agreed rent, occupancy pattern, chores, quiet hours, and guest rules.

PF1.text: Noah's exact offer is $537 per month, Wednesday-Saturday nights only, with Noah cleaning the shared bathroom exactly 3 times per month as part of the deal.

PF2.text: Celeste works overnight shifts and requires quiet from exactly 21:00 to 06:00 every night; she will agree to the room-share only if overnight guests are prohibited.

acceptance_conditions: The room-share must be accepted with Noah selected.
The monthly rent must be exactly $537.
Occupancy must be Wednesday-Saturday nights only.
Noah must clean the shared bathroom exactly 3 times per month.
A chore commitment with type chore and target Noah must be recorded, with its detail stating that Noah cleans the shared bathroom 3 times per month.
Quiet hours must begin at exactly 21:00 and end at exactly 06:00.
Overnight guests must not be allowed.
Celeste's household requirement must be stated aloud and cited in the final settlement.

content_checks.C3: decisions['occupancy_pattern'] in ['Wednesday-Saturday nights only', 'Wednesday through Saturday nights only', 'Wednesday to Saturday nights only']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'chore' and c['target'] == 'Noah' and c['detail'] in ['Clean the shared bathroom exactly 3 times per month', 'Clean the shared bathroom 3 times per month', 'Noah cleans the shared bathroom exactly 3 times per month', 'Noah cleans the shared bathroom 3 times per month'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noah's exact offer changes the settlement to Noah, sets rent at 537, sets Wednesday-Saturday occupancy, sets bathroom cleaning at exactly 3 times per month, and supplies the matching chore commitment.
Celeste's exact household requirement changes the quiet-hour fields to 21 and 6, changes overnight guests to false, and supplies the private statement that must be formally revealed and cited.
